user.title: Add a Pixelblaze
user.description: These Pixelblazes were found on your network.

manual.title: Add a Pixelblaze
manual.description: Enter the host name or IP address of your Pixelblaze.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Pixelblaze.

data.save_to_flash: Save changes to the device's flash

data_description.scan_interval: How often to re-read the full device state. Sequencer pattern changes are pushed instantly; this catches changes made from the Pixelblaze web UI or other apps.
data_description.save_to_flash: Persist brightness and slider changes so they survive a power cycle. They are written 30 seconds after they stop changing, to limit flash wear. Pattern changes are always saved by the device itself.
data_description.control_entities: Create number, switch and light entities for the sliders, toggles and color pickers that patterns expose.

save_preset.name: Save preset
save_preset.description: Save what the Pixelblaze is doing now (pattern, control values, sequencer) as a named preset. Saving with an existing name overwrites it.

include_brightness.name: Include brightness
include_brightness.description: Also restore the current brightness when the preset is recalled.

set_pattern.name: Set pattern
set_pattern.description: Play a pattern (pausing the sequencer), optionally setting its controls.

controls.name: Controls
controls.description: Control values to apply after switching, as a mapping of control name to value (for example sliderSpeed: 0.5).

set_controls.name: Set controls
set_controls.description: Set UI control values on the running pattern. Sliders are 0-1, color pickers are [h, s, v] or [r, g, b] in 0-1.

set_variables.name: Set variables
set_variables.description: Set exported variables on the running pattern.

get_state.name: Get state
get_state.description: Return the full current state of the Pixelblaze: pattern, controls, sequencer, presets and pattern list.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Load a playlist saved in Home Assistant into the Pixelblaze and play it from the start.

user.title: New playlist
user.description: Add patterns with **Add**, drag them by the handle to set the order, and use the pencil or bin icons to edit or remove one.

data_description.items: Played from top to bottom. The same pattern can appear more than once.
data_description.default_duration: Used for any pattern you leave without a duration.

reconfigure.title: Edit playlist
reconfigure.description: Drag patterns by the handle to reorder them; use the pencil or bin icons to edit or remove one.

data_description.items: Played from top to bottom. The same pattern can appear more than once.
data_description.default_duration: Used for any pattern you leave without a duration.

error.name_exists: There's already a playlist with that name.
error.unknown_patterns: These patterns aren't on the Pixelblaze any more; remove or replace them: {missing}
error.too_many_patterns: A Pixelblaze playlist holds at most {max} patterns.

abort.device_unavailable: The Pixelblaze isn't connected. Check that it's online, then try again.
abort.no_device_patterns: The Pixelblaze has no saved patterns.
